title: Every install on a host shares one usage read of each login per five minutes
description: Two temporary installs on one host whose registries name the same Claude login home each select a worker twice within five minutes. The stub usage endpoint counts one request: the first selection reads the provider and writes the windows with their read time into the per-home host record, and every later selection within five minutes reads that record. Both installs' registry rows show the same windows.

steps.name: one usage read per login home per host
